scope: Diagnostic-only observation for the guest Scrape native extension reload route. No frozen artifact, product behavior, auth/org state, acceptance timeout, or inventory edit.

prior_failure.first_unverified_boundary: fixture message dispatch through replacement-worker panel open and reply

implementation.fixture: The actual owned test page records fixed booleans for trusted click entry, sendMessage invocation/return/throw, callback entry, reply presence and runtime.lastError presence. The existing #result reply path remains intact; the receipt reads the fixed fields without retaining error text.
implementation.worker: Only an explicit Scrape reload run with MATRX_SCRAPE_RELOAD_OPEN_DIAGNOSTIC=1 attaches a CDP diagnostic observer to the replacement worker before the trusted click. A second onMessageExternal listener marks matching FRONTEND_RPC/openPanel request ingress; a synchronous wrapper records sidePanel.open invocation and promise settlement, returning the original promise. The listener and wrapper are removed and CDP detached on success and failure.
implementation.acceptance_classification: Default Scrape runs retain the original uninstrumented acceptance path. An opted-in diagnostic receipt says diagnostic_only, ends unverified with nonzero exit even when all cases pass, and cannot be counted as a native acceptance pass.
implementation.target: The existing Target.targetCreated listener now records whether a replacement side-panel target creation event was seen separately from the target poll.
implementation.reply: The existing result observer still classifies the callback reply, and the new fixture fields distinguish absent callback, no reply and runtime.lastError without copying raw text.
implementation.send_response: Unobservable inside the frozen extension through passive CDP. The diagnostic emits unobservable_without_instrumented_build; a separate instrumented CI artifact would be required to prove sendResponse itself. The reply callback and worker-open milestones narrow that gap but do not prove it.

causal_limits: CDP worker attachment can keep a service worker alive; replacing sidePanel.open can perturb gesture timing. The explicit opt-in receipt labels this perturbation, so the diagnostic cannot close acceptance for frozen 0.2.407 or prove the same result occurs without the observer.

The open wrapper observes calls during the probe window. Because the extension listener was registered first, the passive diagnostic ingress listener runs after its synchronous open call; the two markers are correlated by the owned one-click route and fixed request ID, but cannot exclude an unrelated concurrent open without a new instrumented build.
No native run was executed in this lane. The parent owns exact native verification after peer review.
